title: Chameleon in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='bodyGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#4cd94c'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#22a844'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='scarfGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff5c7a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#d92b52'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- tail curl -->
  <path d='M20 78 C10 78 6 68 10 58 C14 48 24 46 28 54 C31 60 26 66 20 64'
        fill='none' stroke='#2fc44f' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='30' ry='18' fill='url(#bodyGrad)'/>

  <!-- back ridge -->
  <path d='M32 52 L37 44 L42 51 L48 43 L53 51 L59 44 L64 52 L68 46'
        fill='none' stroke='#9bf58a' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>

  <!-- belly light patch -->
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='76' rx='20' ry='8' fill='#b8f7a0'/>

  <!-- front legs -->
  <rect x='40' y='80' width='7' height='12' rx='3' fill='#2bb84a'/>
  <rect x='62' y='80' width='7' height='12' rx='3' fill='#2bb84a'/>
  <ellipse cx='43' cy='93' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#59e07a'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='93' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#59e07a'/>

  <!-- scarf -->
  <path d='M38 60 Q50 68 64 59 L66 66 Q50 74 36 67 Z' fill='url(#scarfGrad)'/>
  <path d='M64 60 L76 62 L74 72 L66 69 Z' fill='#ff8399'/>
  <path d='M70 63 L74 63 L73 70 L69 69 Z' fill='#ffd35c'/>

  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='40' rx='19' ry='15' fill='url(#bodyGrad)'/>
  <!-- casque crest -->
  <path d='M50 28 Q56 16 66 26 Q60 26 58 32 Z' fill='#3ad85d'/>
  <!-- eye mount -->
  <circle cx='64' cy='38' r='8' fill='#7ef58f'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='38' r='5' fill='#ffd35c'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='38' r='2.2' fill='#2a1a10'/>
  <circle cx='65.5' cy='36.5' r='1' fill='#fff6d0'/>
  <!-- mouth smile -->
  <path d='M42 46 Q50 50 58 46' fill='none' stroke='#8cf08a' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- nostrils -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='38' r='1.3' fill='#8cf08a'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='37' r='1.3' fill='#8cf08a'/>

  <!-- spots -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='62' r='2.5' fill='#9bf58a'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='66' r='3' fill='#9bf58a'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='70' r='2' fill='#9bf58a'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='72' r='2' fill='#9bf58a'/>
</svg>
